company.name: Vitable Health
company.shortDescription: Vitable Health offers primary care and mental health services through membership.
company.description: Vitable Health provides an integrated primary care and urgent care health plan designed for accessibility and affordability. The membership includes virtual and in-home visits, mental health support, and access to free prescriptions. This model empowers employers to enhance their healthcare offerings while reducing costs and improving employee satisfaction.

productsAndServices.description: A virtual direct primary care membership providing unlimited routine visits, preventive care, mental health support, routine labs, care navigation, and free or discounted prescriptions without copays or deductibles.
productsAndServices.name: Vitable Primary Care

productsAndServices.description: An employer-sponsored reimbursement solution that lets businesses set tax-free monthly health benefit budgets while employees choose individual insurance plans, with Vitable Primary Care included.
productsAndServices.name: ICHRA (Individual Coverage Health Reimbursement Arrangement)

productsAndServices.description: An ACA-oriented health benefits plan that provides minimum essential coverage and preventive services, paired with Vitable Primary Care for broader access to everyday care.
productsAndServices.name: Minimum Essential Coverage (MEC)

productsAndServices.description: A tax-advantaged reimbursement arrangement for small employers that provides employees with funds for eligible individual health expenses and includes Vitable Primary Care.
productsAndServices.name: QSEHRA (Qualified Small Employer Health Reimbursement Arrangement)

productsAndServices.description: A managed ACA compliance service that tracks employee eligibility, automates benefit offers and IRS codes, handles filings, and provides reporting and audit support for variable-hour workforces.
productsAndServices.name: ACA Autopilot

productsAndServices.description: An integrated virtual mental health service offering coaching, counseling, therapy options, medication management, and tools for common concerns such as anxiety, stress, grief, and trauma.
productsAndServices.name: Mental Health

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $8,947,001 to $119,635,287, a 13.37x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 61 (-5 over 90 days) and market heat at 72 (-6).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Talkiatry, Talkspace, Amwell.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
